news.analysis: Hubbard delivered a true workhorse effort Thursday night and was certainly one of the main reasons the Panthers hung around until the end of this contest. Hubbard is having a strong season through seven games, averaging 20 touches for close to 100 yards of offense. He has also found the end zone in five of those games.
news.contents: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 81 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding 38 yards on seven receptions in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.title: Chuba Hubbard gains 119 yards, scores in Thursday's loss

news.contents: Carolina Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard rushed for 81 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries in Thursday night's 27-19 loss to the Green Bay Packers. He added 38 yards and seven receptions on eight looks. Hubbard rebounded from a subpar outing by his standards with a third game of 100-plus scrimmage yards and a rushing touchdown on a day when the Panthers' passing game struggled mightily. As has been the case for most of the 2026 campaign, the Oklahoma State product was Carolina's engine, ...
